title: Black Forest Labs has released FLUX 3 Image Klein, a small open-weights image model that can run on an ordinary graphics card with 8 gigabytes of memory.
key_facts: Black Forest Labs released FLUX 3 Image Klein, 5.6B parameters, open weights
Text-to-image, editing, up to ten reference images, native 4K output
Company says highest Elo among open models in internal testing, beating Ideogram V4.5 and FLUX.2 [pro]
91 Elo points above FLUX.2 [klein] with 38% fewer parameters (9B before)
INT8 build runs on NVIDIA GPUs with 8 GB VRAM; under 9 seconds per image on RTX 4070
FLUX Kommunity License: free commercial use for companies under $5 million annual revenue
API price $0.009 per 1,000 images; also on Hugging Face Spaces, ComfyUI, Diffusers
quote_evidence: Black Forest Labs says it scores the highest Elo ratings among all open models in internal testing, beating closed competitors Ideogram V4.5 and even BFL's own FLUX.2 [pro].
An INT8 build lets it run on NVIDIA GPUs with just 8 GB of VRAM, generating an image in under 9 seconds on an RTX 4070.
The weights ship under the FLUX Kommunity License, free for commercial use by companies making under $5 million annually.
why_it_matters_hint: Image generation that fits on a mid-range gaming graphics card.
